_readme: ADA's corrections to KITOB's data. Applied by scripts/convert-kitob-xlsx.py on every conversion, so they survive future KITOB list imports. Keyed on KITOB's own hotel name exactly as it appears in the list (column B, website removed, whitespace collapsed). An override that matches no hotel is reported as UNUSED: KITOB may have fixed it, so review and retire it. 'field' is a template column (otel_adi, web_sitesi, telefon, eposta, adres); value null clears it. Never edit these hotels by hand in prod; change this file and re-import.

overrides.kitob_name: GRAND PASHA NICOSIA HOTEL CASINO SPA
overrides.reason: KITOB lists goldentulipnicosia.com, which redirects to a generic Golden Tulip page. pashahotels.com/nicosia shows 0392 610 50 50, KITOB's number for this hotel.

KITOB typo. The hotel's own site (doranaarthotel.com), Booking and TripAdvisor all spell it Dorana; the site shows +90 546 992 03 19, KITOB's number. Identity (external_id) stays on the KITOB spelling via kaynak_adi.

KITOB lists doranatourism.com, which lands on a server error page. The likely site, mimozabeachhotel.com, shows 0392 378 81 68 (KITOB: 0392 444 20 50) and presents as 4 stars / 20 rooms (KITOB: 3 stars / 94 beds). Hidden until KITOB confirms the site and phone (vault: questions for KITOB).
